title: Decide when crowded-meta-line reports a label that still shows 12 or more characters
notes: The Modelos formula line on InteliFactu ("Otras operaciones con in...", 3 items, 320px aside) was unreadable yet not reported: about 24 characters stay visible, over MIN_VISIBLE_CHARS (12). Reporting by visible share instead would also report every inbox preview cut on purpose. Options: a share threshold only for labels that name a value beside them; or leave it to the new text-clipped slack check; or no change. The original DOM was not captured, so no faithful fixture exists.
result: Decide when crowded-meta-line reports a label that still shows 12 or more characters
evidence: Decided 2026-11-23 (owner delegated the call): no change to crowded-meta-line. MIN_VISIBLE_CHARS stays the only trigger: a visible-share threshold would report every preview cut on purpose, and no captured DOM exists to build a faithful fixture. A truncated label beside a wider neighbour with room is now reported by the text-clipped slack check; a line with no room to give is a layout choice the tool cannot judge. Reopen with a captured snapshot if the Modelos line still goes unreported after the next ui-quality release.
